summary: The scene grounds Stettler's forensic recognition of Kalt and his turn toward confession in concrete, physically coherent action, but leans on a few specific details (an identifying scar, a mislabeled-ampulle memory, a birth year) that canon never supplies.

issues.unit: P8: "eine alte Narbe, keine aus dieser Nacht"
issues.fix_hint: note that this identifying mark on Kalt has no canon basis (canon defines a physical_mark only for stettler); keep as unglossed detail or ground it in an established fact.

issues.unit: P9: "das Etikett nach oben gedreht, damit er es lesen konnte"
issues.fix_hint: canon only states a 'tödlicher Behandlungsfehler'; the mislabeled-ampulle mechanism is invented beyond that and nothing later can rely on it being an ampulle specifically unless confirmed.
cut the specific birth year or leave the field's content unstated, since canon gives no age or birth year for Kalt.
